_readme: SafeFile JP content plan — 33 episodes, one per week.
Derived from jp_safefile_strategy_v2_2026-10-21.md §6 (30 episodes) with the
changes jp_market_decision_v2_2026-10-22.md §4 requires:
* §6 numbers 1, 14 and 20 were incident-led and first-person. Rewritten as
教育型 pieces about the 最小化原則 — the principle survives, the anecdote
does not. `src` records where each episode came from so the rewrite is
auditable; `rewritten: true` marks the three.
* three new episodes added (ep03, ep05, ep06), all of which lean on
SlimFile compression or an existing landing page rather than new code.
`ep` IS the publishing order and equals `week` — the folder is content/jp/epNN
and scripts/content/make_episode.mjs takes that number. `src` is the strategy
document's own numbering, which is NOT the order any more.
Ordering rules applied (from s7_prompt §A):
* tier-1 (business, 資格確認書 / 入札) first — ep01, ep02
* the two AI-anonymisation pieces inside the first four weeks — ep03, ep04
* the three new SlimFile-combined business pieces next — ep05, ep06 (ep03 is
AI, so the third new one is ep06)
`doc` is the APP'S document key (shikaku_kakuninsho | unten_menkyo |
mynumber_card | juminhyo) when a golden fixture exists for it, because that is
what make_episode.mjs needs to record a demo. Anything else is a plain
Japanese label and means 'no dummy document exists' — the pipeline then writes
demo: "failed: …" into the manifest instead of pretending. null = no single
document (a general or explanatory piece).
`purpose` is one of the four the app offers; `landing` is the CTA target.
`status`: draft (no body yet) → ready (body written, assets built) → posted.
`publish_on` = the Monday the BLOG post goes live, 09:00 JST. ep01 = 2026-10-26.
Strategy v3 §4 prints these dates one day later (all of them are Tuesdays —
cross-review Q5 measured it), so publish_on is that table minus one day;
scripts/content/add_v31_fields.mjs derives it and a Rails test asserts every
value really is a Monday. `blog_title_ja` is the §4 search-intent title and is
what the blog publishes; `title_ja` stays the X/carousel headline. `intent` is
one of 手順 | 理由 | 比較. `verify_before` means the facts must be re-confirmed
before the package may be scheduled (ep30 cites a rule that is not in force,
ep32 describes a feature that has not shipped). `social_skip` means blog only
that week — the X thread and LinkedIn post roll forward to the next Monday.
_forbidden: No incident names (タイムズカー etc.). No first-person victim account.
Never 絶対 / 防ぐ / 唯一 / 必ず安全.
Every how-to carries 「提出先の指示を必ず確認してください」 on its own line.
Dummy card images only as reduced illustrations (long edge <= 800px).
Legal effects stated at most as 「制限される場合があります」.
Unshipped features must not be advertised (see ep32).
